description: Answers questions like "is this a rug?", "who made this coin?", "was it sniped or bundled?" or "can the dev pull the liquidity?" about a token address. Check one token on Robinhood Chain or Solana from the chain itself: who is behind it and how it launched. On Robinhood Chain: where and when it launched, the maker (dev) and its launch record, snipers in the first 3 seconds, wallets the launch made exempt from tax (bundles), flagged wallets, what the maker holds and sold, burned supply, the curve or pool. On Solana (pump.fun coins): mint and freeze authority, metadata, Token-2022 extensions, the creation slot and first 3 seconds, the dev's launch buy and whether it sold, its other pump.fun coins, the curve or graduation, the top holders and who first funded them. Toll's findings are tallied as against / careful / clear. On Robinhood Chain a Verdict line (AGAINST / CAREFUL / CLEAR / INCOMPLETE) sits above the tally: INCOMPLETE means some part was not read yet (never read it as clear) and says when to call again. The answer's first line names the chain. Reads Robinhood Chain (4663) and Solana.

address.description: The token contract address (a Solana mint address works too): 0x followed by 40 hex characters, or a Solana mint address (base58, case-sensitive)

chain.description: Which chain: rh = Robinhood Chain (4663), sol = Solana. Leave it out and Toll finds which chain the token is on.
